repos_data.description: Qwen3.8-27B on one laptop CPU: up to 2.52 token/s, 8 GB tested, no runtime accuracy loss. Native OpenAI-compatible API with function tools; no GPU or Python. | 单颗笔记本 CPU 运行 Qwen3.8-27B：最快 2.52 token/s，最低 8 GB 内存可运行，推理加速不牺牲准确性。原生 OpenAI 兼容接口支持函数工具；无需 GPU 或 Python。
⚡ Pure-Rust WebGPU inference engine — OpenAI-API compatible, GGUF native, runs on any GPU. No Python. No llama.cpp. Single binary.
Off Grid AI — private, on-device AI. Run open models (text, vision, image, voice) locally through one OpenAI-compatible gateway. No cloud, no accounts, no API keys.
Local AI app and inference engine for agents. Run open-weight LLMs locally — private, 100% offline on your computer. Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/8wGSsvmg4V

AI gateway / AI control plane / AI proxy written in Go. Unified OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible API for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, xAI, Ollama, vLLM and more. A LiteLLM alternative with observability, guardrails, streaming, cost tracking, intelligent routing, sticky sessions, failover, real-time logs and usage tracking. Prod ready.
Universal LLM API client — 163 providers, 14 native language bindings, powered by a Rust core
Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models. Supports GGUF, MLX, Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, FLUX and more.

The whole local AI stack in one executable: it runs and manages local AI models across every GPU, and it's a search engine you can talk to, with cited answers from your files, code, and the web. MCP server for coding agents, web crawler, TUI, CLI, REST API, Python library. No Ollama or LM Studio needed, works with both.
WebAssembly binding for llama.cpp - Enabling on-browser LLM inference
All-in-one platform for search, recommendations, RAG, and analytics offered via API
OpenAPI-generated MCP server for TokenLab text, image, video, music, 3D, audio, files, embeddings, rerank, translation, and async tasks.
